synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.text: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of March 3, 2025 (the "Effective Date") by and between Northwind Analytics Ltd., a company incorporated in England ("Northwind"), and Harbor Robotics Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Harbor").

The Receiving Party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party for a period of five (5) years following the termination of this Agreement.

Pursuant to Sec. 2.1, the Receiving Party may share Confidential Information with its advisers who need to know it for the Purpose, subject to prior approval. Each such adviser must be bound by written obligations at least as protective as these.
synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.note: splitter test: "Sec." and "approval." must not merge sentences

synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.text: During the term of this Agreement and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither party shall, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or hire any employee of the other party with whom it had contact in connection with the Purpose.
synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.note: no-solicit of employees (rules only; no model head)

synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.text: For a period of two (2) years after the Effective Date, Harbor shall not engage in, or assist any third party in, the development of any analytics platform that is substantially similar to the Northwind platform.
In the event of any unauthorised disclosure, the breaching party shall pay the disclosing party the sum of USD 250,000, which the parties agree is a genuine pre-estimate of loss and not a penalty.
The Receiving Party shall indemnify and hold harmless the Disclosing Party against all losses arising from any breach of this Agreement.

All feedback, suggestions and improvements relating to the Disclosing Party's technology shall vest exclusively in the Disclosing Party, and the Receiving Party hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein.
This Agreement shall remain in force for three (3) years from the Effective Date.
Northwind may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason, upon ten (10) days written notice to Harbor.
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
Upon a change of control of Harbor, Northwind may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice.
synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.note: change of control (rules only; no model head)

synthetic_mutual_nda.pdf.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.
All notices under this Agreement shall be sent to the addresses set out above.
This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original.

synthetic_residential_lease.pdf.text: This Residential Lease Agreement (the "Lease") is made on June 1, 2025 between Maple Street Properties LLC ("Landlord") and Jordan Rivera ("Tenant") for the premises at 42 Elm Avenue, Apartment 3B, Springfield (the "Premises").
The lease term begins on July 1, 2025 and ends on June 30, 2026.

Thereafter, this Lease shall automatically renew for successive twelve-month terms unless Tenant delivers written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.
Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $1,850 on the first day of each month by bank transfer.
Landlord may raise the rent at any time during the term upon thirty (30) days notice to Tenant.
Tenant forfeits the entire security deposit if Tenant ends this Lease before the end of the term, and the parties agree this amount constitutes liquidated damages and not a penalty.
Landlord may terminate this Lease without cause by giving Tenant thirty (30) days written notice.
Tenant may end this Lease early only by paying an early termination fee equal to two months' rent.
Tenant shall maintain renter's insurance with liability coverage of at least $100,000 and shall name Landlord as an additional insured.
Landlord shall not be responsible for any damage to Tenant's property or injury to any person on the Premises, however caused, including by Landlord's own negligence.
Tenant shall indemnify and hold Landlord harmless from all claims arising from Tenant's use of the Premises.
Nothing in this Lease shall limit or exclude Tenant's liability for damage to the Premises.
Tenant shall keep the Premises clean, sanitary and in good condition.
Smoking is not permitted anywhere inside the Premises.
Landlord reserves the right to change the building rules at any time without notice to Tenant.
Tenant shall not sublet the Premises or assign this Lease without Landlord's prior written consent.
Any dispute arising under this Lease shall be resolved by binding arbitration, and Tenant waives any right to a jury trial.
Tenant agrees not to post negative reviews or disparaging comments about Landlord or the Premises on any website.
This Lease shall be governed by the laws of the State of Illinois.
